guide.simonspacemod.title: Starfleet Handbook
guide.simonspacemod.subtitle: Simon Space Mod
guide.simonspacemod.intro: Welcome aboard, cadet! This handbook explains everything you need for your journey to the stars: resources, power, your own starships, weapons, shields and the great Enterprises out in space. Click a category on the right. Mouse wheel or arrow keys turn pages, right-click or backspace goes back.
guide.simonspacemod.structure.drag:
Drag with left button: turn
Drag with right button: move
Mouse wheel: zoom
Middle button: reset
guide.simonspacemod.category.basics.desc: How to begin: this handbook, your first power sources and the Ship Part Assembly that builds almost every block of the mod.
guide.simonspacemod.category.resources.d: Uranium from the Overworld, dilithium, antimatter and deuterium from the asteroids in space.
guide.simonspacemod.category.power.desc: Nuclear reactors, warp cores, batteries and the ship's grid that powers every device on board.
guide.simonspacemod.category.ships.desc: Build your own ships, take off, fly, walk around on board and climb all the way into space.
guide.simonspacemod.category.weapons.des: Phasers, photon and quantum torpedoes, the weapons station and hand phasers for away missions.
guide.simonspacemod.category.shields.des: Ship shields that wrap around the hull, and base shields that raise a dome over your base.
guide.simonspacemod.category.storage.des: Huge crates, their upgrades and the mining laser that digs for you.
Every ship named Enterprise, from the NX-01 to the NCC-1701-F, and what you find on board.
guide.simonspacemod.welcome.1: You get this book the first time you join a world. Lost it? Craft a new one from a book and lapis lazuli. Some chapters show multiblocks in 3D: "Show in world" puts a glowing building plan where you are looking. Sneak and right-click with the book to remove it.
guide.simonspacemod.welcome.2: Right-click opens the handbook. It remembers where you stopped reading.
guide.simonspacemod.first_steps.1: The Ship Part Assembly builds almost every block of this mod, and it needs power. Without other mods, a shuttle wreck helps: about one in 450 chunks has one on the surface. Inside are a charged battery, a chest with uranium ingots, iron and copper, impulse engines and a helm console.
guide.simonspacemod.first_steps.2: Put the battery next to the assembly. Its charge is enough for the parts of a first 3×3×3 nuclear reactor. After that, the reactor keeps running on uranium. Uranium ore is found in the Overworld at the height of lapis lazuli.
guide.simonspacemod.first_steps.3: Stores 400,000 FE and keeps its charge when mined. Its sides show how full it is.
guide.simonspacemod.assembly.1: The assembly builds every block of this mod from basic materials and power (80 FE per tick). Pick what to build in the table on the right. The search field above it filters by name. Empty slots show in grey what goes in. One slot often takes several of the same item.
guide.simonspacemod.assembly.2: Shift-click puts ingredients straight into the right slot, hoppers fill it and take the result out. Without power it shows "No power". Power comes from the ship's grid, a battery, a reactor next to it or cables of other mods.
guide.simonspacemod.tiers.1: Many parts come in tiers, from the NX-01 to the Enterprise-F. Each higher tier needs two of the previous one and is stronger for it: warp cores, torpedo launchers, shield emitters, base shields and hand phasers. The first tier is made from basic materials. The base shields and shield emitters of the Original Series are the basic shields.
guide.simonspacemod.communicator.1: Right-click with the communicator beams you back to the transporter pad you used last, even onto a flying ship, wherever it is. Active shields in between block the beam.
guide.simonspacemod.uranium.1: Uranium ore and deepslate uranium ore are found in the Overworld around Y 0, from −32 to 32. Mine them with an iron pickaxe or better. You get raw uranium, which a furnace or blast furnace turns into uranium ingots. Uranium ingots fuel the nuclear reactor.
guide.simonspacemod.space_resources.1: Asteroids of stone, tuff, deepslate or basalt float in space. They hold the usual ores plus uranium and dilithium. Their core sometimes holds antimatter clusters. About one asteroid in six is a lump of ice with deuterium ice.
guide.simonspacemod.space_resources.2: Dilithium goes into almost every higher warp core, shield and quantum torpedo.
guide.simonspacemod.space_resources.3: Deuterium is the fuel of all warp cores.
guide.simonspacemod.antimatter.1: Antimatter from the asteroids' clusters becomes antimatter pods at the crafting table with glass and iron. Each craft makes two pods. Warp cores, strong shields and quantum launchers need them.
guide.simonspacemod.reactor.1: The nuclear reactor is a hollow cube from 3×3×3 to 8×8×8 blocks. Its shell is made of reactor casing, reactor glass and exactly one controller. The controller sits in one side and faces outwards.
guide.simonspacemod.reactor.2: The smallest reactor. Glass can go anywhere in the shell.
guide.simonspacemod.reactor.3: The bigger, the more power: 3³ about 530 FE/t, 8³ up to 10,000 FE/t. In return an ingot burns faster (3³: 5 minutes, 8³: about 42 s). Small reactors have 1 input slot, large ones up to 9. When its 1 million FE storage is full it pauses without wasting uranium. Hoppers and pipes can refill uranium.
guide.simonspacemod.warp_cores.1: Warp cores power the whole ship without refuelling. The first one is the NX-01's core, made from iron, antimatter, deuterium and gold.
guide.simonspacemod.warp_cores.2: Each newer core needs two of the previous generation: Original Series, Next Generation, Enterprise-E and Enterprise-F. The newer, the more power, and the bigger the explosion would be in a core breach.
guide.simonspacemod.grid.1: You need no cables in a ship. Every block of this mod (hull, wall, floor …) carries power. Every device touching one of these blocks gets power from the generators connected to it. That includes machines from other mods.
guide.simonspacemod.grid.2: Generators are warp cores, nuclear reactors, batteries and generators from other mods. Everything keeps running in flight.
guide.simonspacemod.power_console.1: At the power distribution console you set how much warp core power each group gets at most: weapons, shields, propulsion, lighting and machines. In battle, turn lighting and machines down so phasers and shields get more.
guide.simonspacemod.power_console.2: Overdrive gives +50% power. Run it longer than 5 minutes and the containment fails: red alert, and after 2 minutes the core explodes. The time keeps adding up until overdrive has been off for 30 minutes in a row.
guide.simonspacemod.battery.1: The battery stores power and hands it to adjacent machines and the ship's grid. The charging station charges space suits, hand phasers and rifles, and devices from other mods too.
guide.simonspacemod.own_ship.1: Build a ship from any blocks and place a helm console inside. Right-click the console to take off. All connected blocks belong to it, up to as many as the game rule max_ship_blocks allows (3000 by default).
guide.simonspacemod.own_ship.2: The hull must be closed: every block touching air on the outside must be a hull block. These are hull plating, hull windows, hull glass, engines, launchers, phasers, deflector, Bussard collectors, navigation lights and airlocks. Otherwise a message names the spot.
guide.simonspacemod.flying.1: H takes the helm. The ship turns towards the crosshair, W gives thrust, S brakes, L lands, Shift leaves the helm. Each impulse engine gives thrust and needs 2000 FE/t from the grid. More engines accelerate faster, big ships are more sluggish.
guide.simonspacemod.flying.3: A and D push the ship left and right, Space up and Ctrl down, always relative to the ship. The inertial dampers brake every direction without thrust. Without a control they run at 10% for free. The inertial damper control sets them from 0 to 100% (right-click opens a menu with a slider that shows the cost); At 10% the ship stops from full speed in 1.5 seconds, at 100% in 3 ticks; 100% costs 1000 FE/t.
guide.simonspacemod.flying.2: The ship keeps its momentum, like in real space. Landing only works slowly and nearly level. Then it turns back into blocks and all chests keep their contents.
guide.simonspacemod.aboard.1: You walk around a flying ship as usual. Gravity always points to the ship's floor, and your view turns with the ship. Shift does not throw you out. You leave through a door or over the edge.
guide.simonspacemod.aboard.2: Chests, furnaces, reactors and machines keep working in flight and can be used with right-click. Chairs work in flight too.
guide.simonspacemod.airlock.1: Two doors one behind the other with a chamber in between. When one side is open, the other is always closed. On your own ships the airlock is the only door that counts as hull.
guide.simonspacemod.space.1: Climb high enough with your ship in the Overworld, above the build height. Then it arrives in space with everyone on board. Space is black with stars, full of asteroids and reaches up to Y 1007.
guide.simonspacemod.space.2: If your ship sinks below Y 12, it returns to the Overworld. Anyone falling out of space without a ship floats down with Slow Falling.
guide.simonspacemod.warp.1: At the helm, J opens the warp menu: destination coordinates, warp factor (slider) and destination (planet or space). With the autopilot the ship flies through the warp dimension to the coordinates and drops out of warp there. In manual mode you fly yourself; arrow up and down change the factor, below warp 1 you drop out.
guide.simonspacemod.warp.2: Warp needs warp nacelles: each at least one Bussard collector and two nacelle grilles close together. One nacelle allows up to warp 5, two nacelles at least 10 blocks apart up to warp 9.9.
guide.simonspacemod.warp.3: Warp costs a lot of power: 2375 × warp² FE/t, an 8×8×8 reactor just manages warp 2. Warp comes first: other consumers are switched off, the inertial dampers are throttled last. If production is not enough, the jump fails right away or the ship drops out of warp at once. Weapons cannot be used at warp.
guide.simonspacemod.cameras.1: Cameras show their live picture on displays of the same structure (connected through blocks of the mod). A camera looks away from the side you place it on. Displays placed next to each other facing the same way become one big screen, as a rectangle from 1×1 to 16×16.
guide.simonspacemod.cameras.2: Right-click a display to see all cameras of the structure; one click picks one. There you can also make a display the main display: at the helm of a flying ship, right-click switches it to the next camera. V at the helm switches between first person and the rear view of the ship. The picture is real (rendered like the game), so a large main display works as a flight screen; every visible camera costs some frame rate.
guide.simonspacemod.space_suit.1: The space suit lets you fly like in creative mode: double-jump switches flight on. Flying costs 20 FE per tick, a full charge lasts 10 minutes. Charge it in the charging station.
guide.simonspacemod.phasers.1: Phaser banks, phaser emitters and phaser strips are a ship's beam weapons. At the helm, holding left-click fires at the crosshair, the mouse wheel picks strength 1 to 3. How hard they hit depends on the ship's warp core.
guide.simonspacemod.phasers.2: The phasers with a clear line of fire that are closest to the target fire. Power comes from the "Weapons" group of the grid.
guide.simonspacemod.torpedoes.1: P fires a photon torpedo. Each tier needs two of the previous one: photon launcher, the full spread launcher of the C and D (F fires all 5 in a fan) and the E's rapid launcher with 5 shots in the magazine.
guide.simonspacemod.torpedoes.2: O fires a quantum torpedo, much stronger. The quantum launcher needs two rapid photon launchers, followed by the rapid quantum launcher and the F's dual quantum launcher, which always fires two torpedoes side by side.
guide.simonspacemod.weapons_station.1: A second player can man the weapons station in flight while the pilot flies. They look through six cameras around the ship and fire phasers and torpedoes. Right-click switches the camera.
guide.simonspacemod.weapons_station.2: When a stationary weapons station gets a redstone signal, its phasers fire on their own at tier 1 at hostile creatures within 96 blocks.
guide.simonspacemod.hand_phasers.1: For away missions: hand phasers of every era. The NX phaser is made from basic materials, each newer one from two of the previous era. V switches between stun and kill, hold left-click to fire.
guide.simonspacemod.hand_phasers.2: Phaser rifles are stronger and last longer. The NX rifle is made from two NX phasers, each newer one from two of the previous.
guide.simonspacemod.ship_shields.1: Place a shield emitter and a shield console in the ship. When switched on, the shield forms about 2 blocks in front of the hull. Every shield block has health, 260 to 1420 depending on tier. Explosions, phasers and torpedoes wear it down.
guide.simonspacemod.ship_shields.2: The shield only lights up when hit: blue, yellow when low, red when almost broken. With power it recovers. Your own weapons fire out through your own shield.
guide.simonspacemod.base_shield.1: The base shield raises a dome around itself with a radius of 16 to 128 blocks. It only needs power, no emitters.
guide.simonspacemod.base_shield.2: It has the same tiers as the ship shields. The first is the basic shield, each further one needs two of the previous. Anyone inside can fire out.
guide.simonspacemod.crates.1: Build a hollow box from crate blocks. Each edge may be 3 to 8 blocks long, even unequal. All blocks must be the same tier. Once the last block is placed, it becomes a crate.
guide.simonspacemod.crates.2: The smallest crate. Every block counts like a chest of its tier, even the air inside.
guide.simonspacemod.crates.3: The menu shows 9 × 9 slots with a scroll bar and buttons to sort: by name, mod or amount. Every block takes items from hoppers and pipes.
guide.simonspacemod.crate_upgrades.1: Tier upgrades raise a finished crate to a higher tier with right-click, even straight from wood to netherite. You need one upgrade per block. The contents stay.
guide.simonspacemod.crate_upgrades.2: Stack upgrades in the 4 slots on the right of the menu multiply how much fits in a slot: 2× to 32×. Several upgrades multiply.
guide.simonspacemod.mining_laser.1: The mining laser digs downwards, layer by layer, up to 16×16 blocks wide and 32 deep. The yield goes into 9 slots or a crate next to it. It needs 250 FE per block and starts switched off.
guide.simonspacemod.mining_laser.2: The laser focus in the outer hull guides the beam, so the laser can sit inside the ship. The laser control console switches all lasers in the ship on and off.
guide.simonspacemod.enterprises.1: In space, every 1000 × 1000 area has a full-size Enterprise. The newer, the rarer: NX-01, NCC-1701, -A, -B, -C, -D, -E and the huge Odyssey class -F.
guide.simonspacemod.enterprises.2: With permission you can also build them with /enterprise spawn, full size or scaled down. Each has a bridge, decks, engineering with its warp core, sickbay, transporter room, armory and much more. Small example ships that fly right away are available with /simonship spawn (miner, reactor_small, reactor_large, warp5, warp9); their reactors spawn full.
guide.simonspacemod.turbolift.1: Right-click a turbolift to see all stops of the ship, named by deck. One click takes you there. Your own lifts can be named and linked into networks.
guide.simonspacemod.transporter.1: Right-click a transporter pad to open its menu: "Beam to the surface" at the top, below it all other transporters within 500 blocks, including those of flying ships. An active shield between start and destination blocks the transport.
guide.simonspacemod.doors.1: Ship doors open by themselves when you stand in front of them. Security doors (yellow stripe) need the security card, command doors (red) the command card; having it in your inventory is enough. Shift + right-click with a card in hand locks a door.
guide.simonspacemod.doors.2: The captain's card opens every door on board. What it has locked, only it can open.
guide.simonspacemod.armory.1: Behind a security door, every Enterprise has an armory with rifle racks and phaser holders, filled with weapons of its era.
